# Previews

Page images of `../full-system.html` — the one-paper document — captured at 1328×6000 each and
covering it end to end: cover, all six templates, and every guideline card.

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `full-system-1.png` | Cover · guest surface · docs · permission gate |
| `full-system-2.png` | Roster · degraded states · Station Console |
| `full-system-3.png` | Iconography · imagery · environment at four precisions · lockups · wordmark |
| `full-system-4.png` | Colour · type · spacing |
| `full-system-5.png` | Components · conformance · retrofit |

They exist because two things do not survive an HTML-to-image capture, and reviewers keep hitting
both:

- **Iframe content.** `../../cards/doctrine-review-*.card.html` mount real template DCs in iframes.
  Those frames are blank in any capture. Review those cards live.
- **PDF export.** The document is print-ready via `<doc-page>`, but PDF comes out of the browser's
  print destination rather than from a file this package can generate. These images are the
  fallback: drop them into any images-to-PDF tool if you need one.

Regenerate by opening `../full-system.html` and capturing it in 6000px slices.
